build_package_protos: build Python and gRPC stubs from all .proto files in a package directory
build_package_protos_strict: build Python gRPC stubs from proto files and raise an exception on failure
BuildPackageProtos_run: run the setuptools command to generate protobuf modules from proto files in the distribution package
BuildPackageProtos_strict_mode: run the setuptools BuildPackageProtos command with strict mode to fail on proto compilation errors
BuildPackageProtos_initialize_options: initialize the BuildPackageProtos setuptools command with strict mode set to False by default
